Beginners Guide
Starting Linggango
Your journey begins as you strive to become the strongest and most legendary hero — everything is in your hands.
When you first enter the world, your spawn location is random — you might find yourself in a desert, swamp, forest, or wide open plains.
Don’t worry — no matter where you begin, your Quest Book will guide you through your adventure.
As you explore, you’ll come across various structures scattered throughout the world.
These structures often contain chests filled with valuable loot and resources, which can greatly help you grow stronger in the early stages of your journey.
Make sure to check every building you find — some may even hide rare items or clues about upcoming challenges!
Introducing Quest Book
The Quest Book is your main companion throughout the game, helping you track your progress and objectives.
You can find it in the top left corner when you open your inventory.
When you open it, you’ll see an introduction page filled with tutorials, goals, and helpful tips.
From the Main Progression section, you can follow your primary story path and take stronger steps toward your ultimate goal.
Each time you complete a quest, the book will reward you with valuable items or progression.
Ring of Seven Curses: This is considered hard mode. Do not put this on unless you are certain you want to. Once it is on, you cannot take it off.
First Step
In the Main Progression section, your first quest — “Iron Colossus” — introduces you to your first major boss.
Defeating the Iron Colossus unlocks iron weapons, armor, and tools, allowing you to grow stronger.
After defeating the boss, you can claim your boss rewards directly from the Quest Book and use the loot dropped by the boss to enhance your power even further.
